ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  REGULAR MEETING
  AGENDA
  111 South First Street
  March 9, 2021
  7:30 P.M.
  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE

Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the State of
California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer At Home Order, the Alhambra Design
Review Board meeting will not be physically open to the public and the meeting will take place via
teleconference and video conference.

To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency and public
access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Meeting as follows:

Zoom Meeting direct link:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87356618112?pwd=aE92bTZGVnlLU1NPUTY2LzFIV0tadz09
Meeting ID: 873 5661 8112 and Password: 633778

Or by telephone by dialing 1 253 215 8782, 1 345 248 7799, 1 669 900 6833, 1 312 626 6799, 1 929 205 6099 or
1 301 715 8592 and entering Meeting ID: 873 5661 8112 and Password: 633778. Please Note: All members of
the public calling or logging into the meeting will be muted so that the meeting can proceed.

For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please email Erin Joson at eung@cityofalhambra.org no later
than 5:30 p.m. prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and the phone number you
will use when calling or the name you will use when logging into the meeting. You should then call or log into
the meeting at least 10 minutes prior to its start time. Staff will unmute you and announce you when it is your
time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by the Chairperson. If you do not
have access to a computer please call 626-570-5034 to request public comment.

As an alternative you can email your comments by sending them to the Design Review Board by email at
eung@cityofalhambra.org no later than 5:30 p.m. to ensure that Design Review Board Staff have time to print
the emails prior to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with a maximum
allowance of 5 minutes per individual comment, subject to the Chairperson’s discretion. If a comment is received
after 5:30 p.m. but before the beginning of the meeting based upon its time stamp, the comment will still be
included as a part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.

Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should email
or call the Community Development Department at plam@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5034. All requests
for accommodations or translation services shall be made by 4:00 p.m. the Thursday prior to the Design Review
Board meeting. If accommodation or translation is not requested by 4:00 p.m. the Thursday prior to the Design
Review Board meeting, staff will try to accommodate the request to the best of their efforts to provide as much
accessibility as possible while also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of teleconference and video
conference meetings, all participants are encouraged to email their comments prior to the beginning of the
meeting.

CONSENT CALENDAR (No Consent Items):

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to be
routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration. Items
placed under Consent Calendar include smaller scale projects with no or minor design
issues and ministerial matters (minutes).

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

1.  1508 South Marengo Avenue
This is an application for a new 2-story commercial building within an existing skilled
nursing facility.
Applicant: TAG-2 Medical Investment Group, LLC

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval with the condition
that MWELO compliant documents shall be provided at the time of building plan check.

PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:
Citizens wishing to address the Alhambra Design Review Board on any matter within the
subject matter jurisdiction of the Alhambra Design Review Board not on the Agenda may
do so at this time. Please STATE YOUR NAME AND ADDRESS CLEARLY for the record.

Please note that while the Alhambra Design Review Board values your comments, pursuant
to January 1, 1987 amendments of the Brown Act, the Commission cannot respond nor take

  1
 any action until such time as the matter may appear as an item on a forthcoming agenda.

ADJOURNMENT:
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Alhambra Design Review Board will be held
on Tuesday, March 23, 2021, at 7:30 p.m. Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20
and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the State of California and the County
of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer At Home Order, the Alhambra Design
Review Board meeting will not be physically open to the public and the meeting will take
place via teleconference and video conference.

NOTICE:
AGENDA ITEMS: Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each
item of business described hereinabove are on file in the offices of the Community
Development Department in City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California, and are
available for public inspection during regular office hours, which are 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any of the above
agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, he or she may contact the Community
Development Director either in person at the Department offices, or by telephone at (626)
570-5034 during regular office hours.

AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT: If you require special assistance to participate in any
City meeting (including assisted listening devices) please contact the Community
Development Department at (626) 570-5034. Notification of at least 72 hours prior to the
meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this
meeting.

TRANSLATION SERVICES REQUESTS: If you require translation services in order to
participate in a meeting please contact the Community Development Department at
plam@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5034. All requests for translation services shall be
made by 4 p.m. the Thursday prior to the Design Review Board meeting. If translation is not
requested by 4 p.m. the Thursday prior to the Design Review Board meeting, staff will try to
accommodate the request if possible.

APPEALS: Any person wishing to appeal any decision of the Design Review Board to the
Planning Commission may do so by filing an appeal in writing along with the appropriate
appeal fee to the Community Development Department in City Hall within 10 calendar
days of the Design Review Board decision. The appeal period for items on this agenda
expires at the close of business on March 22, 2021.

  ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  REGULAR MEETING
  AGENDA
  111 South First Street
  March 9, 2021
  7:30 P.M.

ADDRESS: 1508 South Marengo Avenue
APPLICANT: TAG-2 Medical Investment Group, LLC
PROJECT TYPE: This application is for a new 2-story commercial building within an
existing skilled nursing facility.
PROJECT STATUS: Continued Applicant

DESIGN ASSESSMENT: This application was last heard at the February 9, 2021 Design
Review Board meeting where it was continued to allow the applicant to study
alternatives for the textured concrete walls and the metal pipe details. The application
proposes a new 2-story skilled nursing facility. The new building will total 11,286 square
feet and accommodate 34 beds. The adjacent existing building accommodates 99 beds
and is similar in height. Given the 1.6 acre campus size and the siting of the proposed
building, there is little visual impact of the new building to the street. The architectural
style of the building is contemporary and is generally consistent with the primary
building. The revised design uses die-cut fiber cement panels as stair rails and removes
the vertical metal pipes that enclosed the circulation area. Green walls have also been
introduced to soften the textured stucco panels on both the east and west
elevations. Stucco is also the primary finish for the other buildings within the facility
making it a compatible design. Given the existing condition of the campus, the
landscape should not be affected by the new work, however, any MWELO compliant
documents shall be provided at the time of building plan check.

RECOMMENDATION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that MWELO
compliant documents shall be provided at the time of building plan check.
